dissent: Multiple road notices establish an information supply, not a recurring customer problem.
Original municipal notices or couriers' existing workflows may already be sufficient; a separate digest could add reading rather than save time.
Four returns after two briefings could reflect curiosity. That threshold would justify further learning, not a demand or revenue claim.
